blocking.test: caption or slide copy contains 'FDA-approved' or 'FDA approved' within 200 chars of a compounded product or peptide name
blocking.reason: Misleading promotion of a compounded drug is misbranding under 21 U.S.C. 352(bb). Active FDA enforcement area.
blocking.fix: Remove the claim, or name the mechanism instead.

blocking.test: copy asserts a specific health outcome rather than a mechanism
blocking.reason: FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance requires competent and reliable scientific evidence, generally RCT-grade, for health-benefit claims. Use 'may support <mechanism>', never 'erases/cures/fixes'.
blocking.fix: Rewrite as a mechanism: “may support …”, “aimed at …”.

blocking.test: copy contains 'starting at', 'as low as', 'from $', 'and up'
blocking.reason: CA Bus & Prof Code 651(c) requires exact prices. Range pricing is prohibited.
blocking.fix: State an exact price, or no price at all.

blocking.test: post includes a photo of a person and the caption lacks a model/AI disclosure line
blocking.reason: CA Bus & Prof Code 651(b)(3)(B) — unlabeled stock imagery is a violation on its own. AI-generated people are untested under this rule; disclose.
blocking.fix: Add the disclosure line to the caption.

blocking.reason: Instagram caps hashtags at 5. Using them at volume measured -31.7% views.

blocking.test: copy or reply text identifies, confirms, or implies that a named individual is a patient
blocking.reason: The only fact pattern OCR has actually penalized on social media. $10,000-$50,000 range. Applies to comment and review replies as well as posts.
blocking.fix: Remove anything that identifies or implies an individual is a patient.

blocking.test: copy contains a patient testimonial or quoted outcome
blocking.reason: Requires a standalone signed authorization under 45 CFR 164.508, never bundled into intake. A testimonial also cannot carry a claim the practice could not make directly.
blocking.fix: Remove the testimonial, or obtain a standalone 45 CFR 164.508 authorization first.

blocking.test: a compounded product or peptide is named but the protocol slide omits the FDA disclaimer
blocking.reason: Promotion of a compounded drug without the non-FDA-reviewed disclaimer is misleading under 21 U.S.C. 352(a) and is an active FDA enforcement area.
blocking.fix: Add the compounded disclaimer to the protocol slide.

params.disclaimer_text: Compounded medications are prepared per individual prescription and are not reviewed by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for safety or efficacy. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. Individual results vary. Treatment is determined at evaluation and is not guaranteed.

warnings.test: copy addresses the reader as having a medical condition (second person)
warnings.reason: Compliant organically; breaks Meta ad policy the moment the post is boosted. Flag so a human decides before promoting.
warnings.fix: Fine organically. Re-read before boosting this post as an ad.

warnings.test: copy implies female hormone replacement therapy
warnings.reason: Practice lists male hormone optimization only. Confirm scope before publishing.
warnings.fix: Confirm the practice's published scope covers this before publishing.

warnings.test: caption asks for a comment keyword
warnings.reason: Comment-keyword CTAs are how this account routes interest into DMs. Required caption element.
warnings.message: Caption has no comment-keyword call to action.
warnings.fix: Add a line like “Comment PANEL and I will send you …”.

warnings.test: caption offers the free consult and says where care is available
warnings.reason: Required caption element for this tenant. The consult is the practice's only conversion path.
warnings.message: Caption is missing the consult line.
warnings.fix: Add the 15-minute consult line with the link-in-bio pointer.

hook.rule: One symptom in the patient's own words. Never a service name.

cause.rule: This is the slide people save. One line per driver.

protocol.rule: Name mechanisms, never outcomes. Disclaimer is mandatory when a compounded product is named.

cta.rule: Identical on every carousel. It becomes recognizable.
